exposure: women undergoing their first embryo transfer
recombinant human LH (r-hLH) or human menopausal gonadotropin (hMG) in combination with recombinant human follicle-stimulating hormone (r-hFSH)
cohort: Women receiving GnRH antagonist protocol and r-hFSH+hMG or r-hFSH+r-hLH regimen for over five days for COH in the in vitro fertilization (IVF)/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) cycle in Taiwan from 2013 to 2018.
finding: The r-hFSH+r-hLH group had higher numbers of oocytes retrieved, mature oocytes, and fertilized oocytes, and a higher cumulative pregnancy rate, while other outcomes were comparable between the two groups.
